office_does: A district court judge hears misdemeanors, gross misdemeanors, city-ordinance violations, traffic infractions and preliminary hearings in Chelan County.
race_blurb: Uncontested: Presiding Judge Jon Volyn, who won the open seat in 2022, is the only candidate for a four-year term.

candidates.summary: Presiding judge of Chelan County District Court, elected in 2022 after four years as a part-time judge; the only candidate on the ballot.
highlights: Elected in 2022 with 52.29% over Allen F. Blackmon; part-time judge 2018-2022 [S1][S4]
Says he has more than 25 years of legal experience and has presided over more than 30 jury trials [S1]
Described the court's 2024 therapeutic court as a way for some defendants to get help and avoid a conviction [S6]
